svg.data-capacity: 3.2 Tbps full duplex (1.6 Tbps per sled)
svg.data-input-dc: -40 to -72 VDC, 40 A max per PS
svg.data-temperature-operating: 0 C to 45 C (32 F to 113 F)
svg.data-software: ONIE installer pre-loaded; open-source and commercial NOS options
svg.data-timing: IEEE 1588v2 PTP up to Class C; 1PPS output per sled
svg.data-sleds: 2x AMX-3200-SLED400 (2x 400G CFP2-DCO + 8x 100G QSFP28 each); a blank cover for an unused slot
svg.data-mgmt-ports: 1x RJ-45 RS-232 console, 1x RJ-45 100/1000BASE-T management, 1x 1G SFP management, 1x USB 2.0, 2x 1PPS coaxial (one per sled), 1x 4 mm banana receptacle
svg.data-emc: EN 55032 Class A, EN 300 386 Class A, EN 61000-3-2, EN 61000-3-3, VCCI Class A, AS/NZS Class A, ICES-003 Class A, FCC Class A, BSMI Class A

rect.data-members: console oob-sfp mgmt-eth usb esd sled1-1pps sled2-1pps led-psu led-diag led-fan led-loc
